youtube.title: Why Seashells Sound Like the Ocean 🐚 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The roar in a seashell is not the sea trapped inside. Any hollow object, even a coffee mug, makes the same sound. The air around you is always full of faint noise, and the shell's hollow shape resonates and boosts certain pitches of it. Your brain hears that as a rushing ocean.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
